phase_current_direction: Positive A/B enters first bar at negative Y and exits its positive Y face; positive C enters at positive Y and exits negative Y. Consecutive same-phase bars alternate direction.

lead_and_bus_allocation.status: Protected routing allocation; leads and joints are not yet detailed physical conductors and are excluded from coil-solid mass/resistance.

A_B_negative_side.z: same separated phase lane as associated endlinks

C_positive_side.route: Open positive-Y carrier throat; separate from fixed support arms below Z=-7

lead_and_bus_allocation.topology: Three separately accessible series windings; star or delta interconnection is an external inverter/interface decision. No internal star point is assumed.
lead_and_bus_allocation.ratings: Current-density, bend/joint resistance, creepage, vacuum insulation, harness heating and inverter voltage are same-revision analysis requirements. The 21mm2 neck governs conservative current density.
